backgroundLanguage.title: Notification and message language
backgroundLanguage.explanation: This shared setting applies to notifications and new Placet-generated messages for this installation. It does not change this browser’s interface language or translate existing conversations. Only the human supervisor can change it.
backgroundLanguage.label: Background language
backgroundLanguage.saved: Saved. New notifications and Placet messages will use this language.
backgroundLanguage.loadError: Unable to load the setting. Close and reopen to retry.
backgroundLanguage.saveError: Unable to save. Your choice is still selected; try again.

usage.title: Usage
usage.staleClaude: Last updated {{time}}: open Claude Code in a terminal once to renew its login, then Placet can read the usage again.

node.title: Node name
node.explanation: A node is a stable name for this conversation: other sessions can address it, and it moves to the new conversation after /clear.
node.name: Name
node.nameRule: Up to 40 letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores.
node.attachLabel: Or attach to an existing node
node.deleteConfirm: Delete node “{{name}}”? Its sessions stay, without a name.

relations.title: Relations
relations.incoming: From the other node to this one
relations.typeDescription: When and why to contact the other session: the agent reads this.
relations.manual: Manual: I review, edit or reject each prompt
relations.automaticHint: Prompts on this relation reach the other session directly. Replies come back without review only if the reverse relation is automatic too.
relations.deleteConfirm: Delete this relation? Future prompts will need your review.
relations.explanation: This request continues as usual. The relation applies to future requests between these two sessions.
relations.created: Relation created: it applies to future requests.
relations.ruleHint: Agents must read it before every prompt they send on an automatic relation; Placet sends nothing until they confirm it. Applies to all relations.
relations.rulePlaceholder: E.g. Before starting processes, if you have important doubts, ask the user through Placet's tools.
relations.ruleActive: Rule active: agents read it before each automatic send.
relations.ruleEmpty: No rule: automatic relations deliver at once.

automation.paused: Automatic relations paused: every prompt waits for your review.
automation.maxPerHour: Automatic prompts per hour per relation

push.title: Notifications on this device
push.install: To receive notifications that open Placet, add Placet to the Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen) and open it from there. On iPhone this needs iOS 16.4 or later.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for Placet. Allow them in the system settings (Notifications → Placet), then come back here.
push.off: Placet can notify this device about questions, prompts to approve and finished turns. Tapping a notification opens Placet on that request.
push.on: Notifications are active on this device.
push.enabled: Done: this device will receive Placet's notifications.
push.denied: Permission not granted: notifications stay off.
push.testSent: Test sent: it should arrive in a few seconds.
push.error: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
push.privacy: Notifications travel through the browser vendor's push service (Apple on iPhone), encrypted; they carry only a short title, never the text of the requests.
